profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Jose, California, and traded under the ticker SMCI. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001375365. On its own website the company describes itself as a premier provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for 5G/Edge, Data Center, Cloud, Enterprise, Big Data, HPC and Embedded markets worldwide.

Its site presents GPU servers for modern data centers and describes its AI systems as its most comprehensive, featuring multi-GPU and interconnect technologies. It also describes short-depth and small form factor systems built to deliver compute, AI and connectivity performance at the edge of the network. Its litigation exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 264.
